cases.title: Review, the learner says nothing should snap: the review ends and nothing is recorded

rubric.reason: In Turn 3 the mentor accepts 'Nothing here should snap' with 'there's nothing to review here', ends kindly with 'run this again and we'll do it there', makes no record call, and says 'The review is still open', so the skill stays due.
Across Turns 1–3 the review only asks what is meant to snap and asks about Cut's Opacity at 3 s; it never gives a demo, walkthrough, menu path, how-to tip or reteach.

After the learner said "Nothing here should snap," Turn 3 ends the review kindly ("We'll end the review here. I haven't recorded anything, so it's still due"), makes no record call, invents no target, and adds only one brief line of context rather than a lecture.
The review in Turns 2–3 only asks the intent question and names Cut's Opacity at 3 s as a question; it gives no menu path, no how-to tips, no demo or offer of one, and no reteach.
In turn 3 the mentor accepts "Nothing here should snap" with "Got it, Cut stays a fade... I'll end the review here. It's still due," makes no record call, invents no target and gives no lecture.
Turn 1 gives the task in a sentence ("you make something snap on your own, with no walkthrough, and I check it"), and no turn names a menu or panel, gives tips, offers a demo or reteaches.
